'''Ses Jopp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Jopp held a hatred of [[Larin Moxla]], calling her "Toxic Moxla." However, when dispatched to [[Sebaddon]] to help [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|eradicate]] the [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]], he assisted Moxla and befriended her. After the battle, which Jopp survived, Moxla considered organizing a Special Forces squad made up of Sebaddon survivors, and she considered asking Jopp to join.
